text:
nina: Heads-up: after the console patch yesterday, we're seeing mismatched route attribution between the quota dashboard and the per-route latency tiles for some customers. Seems correlated with clients using legacy route header and the new TS/Go SDKs.

raph: saw this too. the quota numbers are higher than tokens shown per-route. might be double-counting when both `X-Redwood-Route` and `X-Redwood-Route-V2` are present.

kevin: quick summary of what changed: TS/Go SDKs (v1.13/v0.9) started emitting V2 header encoded as semicolon pairs `tenant=acme;tier=premium`. Proxy still emits legacy comma list. console parser was updated to accept both but doesn't unify formats.

sara: can we canonicalize at ingestion before metrics aggregation? right now quota service uses header split by comma, while latency tiles use the top-most header verbatim.

nina: ingestion change makes sense but risky during rollout. proposal: SDKs add a header negotiation handshake: send `X-Redwood-Route-Negotiate: v2` and proxy will reply `X-Redwood-Route-Negotiate: v2,accepted` or `none`. then we can slowly flip aggregator to prefer V2.

raph: I like negotiation but that adds RTT on connect. could be optional and cached per-connection. For serverless SDKs maybe cache in env var or ephemeral file.

kevin: alternate smaller step: make console & quota aggregator treat both headers as sets, normalize separators `[,;]`, split on equals/colon, and dedupe keys by name preferring V2 values. That would be non-breaking and fix double-counting immediately.

sara: +1 for normalization patch. also need a migration plan so customers with custom middleware that mutates header don't break. Add a debug toggle to log merged header for 1% of requests.

telemetry-bot: Note: created ticket TELEMETRY-8812 to add canonicalizer + merged-header logging.

nina: rollout UX: we'll show a banner on quota dashboard when merged headers are detected: "multiple route sources detected - values merged" and link to docs on SDK header migration. Need short copy.

raph: copy suggestion: "Route attribution merged from client and proxy. If you see unexpected splits, check SDK version / middleware. Learn more."

kevin: for SDKs, plan:
- TS/Go: emit negotiate header behind opt-in flag (default off) in next release
- patch docs and changelog
- in 2 weeks enable opt-in canary for 5% of npm/go users via feature flag in console docs (callouts)

sara: also update quota alerting rule: if per-route quota > cluster quota by >5% for a sustained 10min, open automated investig ticket. avoids noisy manual triage.

infra-bot: INFRA-5023 created to add header preference to proxy config (prefer V2 when present).

nina: Action items:
- @kevin normalization patch for quota aggregator + console canonicalizer (telemetry-8812)
- @raph add negotiate header to TS/Go SDKs behind REDWOOD_ROUTE_NEGOTIATE flag + tests
- @sara add merged-header banner and docs link + quota alert tweak
- infra to update proxy preference and add canary rollout plan (INFRA-5023)
- telemetry to enable merged-header debug logging for 1% sampling

raph: I'll open the SDK PR today. example flag usage:
```
// env
export REDWOOD_ROUTE_NEGOTIATE=true

// ts sdk will send
headers['X-Redwood-Route-Negotiate']='v2'
```

kevin: I'll draft aggregator patch and add unit tests for mixed formats. After CI we can ship a hotfix to telemetry service.

sara: once infra flips preference we should schedule a cross-team sync to confirm dashboards align. ping me when infra has a rollout window.

nina: thanks all. keeping this thread as the source of truth for rollout coordination. ping if you hit edge cases (customers with proxies that rewrite headers, esp).
